issue.title: Bug: Invalid queue index error in packet_trimming/test_packet_trimming_config_*.py

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

```
2026 Jul 11 <IPV6>.550355 qspf305 ERR swss#orchagent: :- validateQueueIndexCap: Failed to validate queue index: value(9) is out of range: 0 <= index <= 7
2026 Jul 11 <IPV6>.550355 qspf305 ERR swss#orchagent: :- setSwitchTrimming: Failed to validate switch trimming queue index: capability is not supported
```

This issue happens on Arista-7060X6-64PE-B for certain topos

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `packet_trimming/test_packet_trimming_config_symmetric.py` or `packet_trimming/test_packet_trimming_config_asymmetric.py` on Arista-7060X6-64PE-B with t0-f2-d10u8 topo.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

This test configuration shouldn't throw any errors if the queue index in the test is changed.
